values.meaning: Bonus Attack Damage per 1% missing health
values.binNote: Wiki derives this as MaximumBonusAD / 90 (low threshold); bin has no direct data value for it, only the max AD figures used to compute it.
Restates BaseHeal + HealPerFury*100 fury; tooltip-only calc, not an independent value

mechanics.claim: Bloodlust can still be activated even if Tryndamere does not have any Fury.
mechanics.quote: ''Bloodlust'' can still be activated even if '''Tryndamere''' does not have any '''Fury'''.

mechanics.claim: Casting Bloodlust during an attack windup uses the crit chance from before the cast, but Fury is granted once the windup completes, letting Tryndamere start building Fury immediately.
mechanics.quote: This means that if {{ai|Bloodlust|Tryndamere}} is cast during Tryndamere's {{tip|attack windup}}, the attack will use the {{tip|critical strike}} chance given by the {{as|Fury}} '''before''' the {{ai|Bloodlust|Tryndamere}} cast.

mechanics.claim: Bloodlust's passive grants bonus attack damage based on missing health, up to a maximum at a set missing-health percentage.
mechanics.quote: '''Tryndamere''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} based on his {{as|'''missing''' health}}, up to a maximum amount at {{as|{{#var:low}}% '''missing''' health}}.

mechanics.claim: The active consumes all current Fury to heal, with the heal amount increased per point of Fury consumed.
mechanics.quote: '''Tryndamere''' consumes all of his {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}} to {{tip|heal}} himself, increased for every point of {{as|Fury}} consumed.
